simple.summary: נְדִיבָה (nᵉdîybâh) means properly, nobility , i.e. reputation First listed occurrence: Job 30 15.

definitions.full: H5082. nedibah [ נְדִיבָה ] noun feminine nobility, nobleness ; — suffix נְדִבָתִי Job 30:15 ; plural נְדִיבוֺת Isa 32:8 (twice in verse); — 1 nobility of rank, honour Job 30:15 . 2 plural = noble things as counselled by the נדיב in character Isa 32:8 (twice in verse).
